summary: Iteration 3: Verified interlinking/navigation features. Backend: 28/29 pytest pass (5 new convert tests + 24 regression). One security bug: /api/deals/{deal_id}/convert lacks the client-role guard that /api/leads/{id}/convert has, so a logged-in client user could convert deals in their org (returns 200 instead of 403). Frontend Playwright E2E: all critical flows pass — owner login OK; Dashboard KPI cards (Total Leads, Pipeline Value, Active Clients) navigate correctly; Leads page shows 12 'Convert to Deal' row actions (data-testid convert-<leadId>) — clicking POSTs /api/leads/{id}/convert, toast success, row hides; Deals page shows 9 'Convert to Client' row actions with correct label; Header Quick-Add 'New' menu -> New Lead navigates to /leads and auto-opens create dialog (title 'New Lead'); New Deal auto-opens deal create dialog; Cmd+K (Ctrl+K) opens CommandDialog with command-input; typing 'invoices' + selecting command-invoices navigates to /invoices; clicking global-search opens palette; deep link /clients?new=1 auto-opens the New Client dialog.

critical.issue: Missing client-role guard; a client-role user can convert any deal in their org (creates client+project, marks deal Won). Should return 403 like /api/leads/{id}/convert. Add: if user.get('role') == 'client': raise HTTPException(403, 'Not allowed') at start of convert_deal (server.py ~line 705).

issues: Radix warnings: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby; CommandDialog inner DialogContent requires DialogTitle for a11y (wrap with VisuallyHidden). Non-blocking but flooding console.

action_items: Add client-role 403 guard at top of convert_deal() in /app/backend/server.py (mirror the check in convert_lead).
Optional a11y polish: add DialogDescription to create/edit dialogs and wrap Command palette DialogTitle with VisuallyHidden to remove console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Security parity gap: convert_lead enforces role != client but convert_deal does not — clients technically shouldn't have UI to reach it but the API is exposed and should defense-in-depth 403.
convert_deal does not persist deal.value into the created client consistently vs lead->deal budget parsing (minor).
Layout.jsx CommandDialog: no Quick-create for Client/Task/Invoice in the palette (only Lead/Deal) — inconsistent with the header Quick-Add menu which lists all five. Consider adding for parity.
server.py still ~1046 lines; split into routers as feature surface grows.

Frontend testids introduced this iteration: convert-<leadId>, convert-<dealId>, quick-add-button, quick-add-lead, quick-add-deal, global-search, command-input, command-<slug>, dashboard-kpi-<label-slug>. Deep-link ?new=1 auto-open works on all resources with hideCreate=false.
rca of the issue: convert_deal endpoint (server.py ~L704) was implemented without the `if user.get('role') == 'client': raise HTTPException(403)` guard that exists in convert_lead (L566-567). Reproduction: login as client@demo.com, obtain any deal_id in same org, POST /api/deals/{id}/convert -> returns 200 with new client+project. Mitigation: add the two-line role check at the top of convert_deal.
